title: Jake Sullivan in at least one UAP briefing
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Jake Sullivan in at least one UAP briefing, about 2023-2024 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ross Coltard says that he know he knows that uh that um that Salt Jake was in at least one briefing

plain: Matthew Pines, a commentator on national security, says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2024 that the journalist Ross Coulthart knows that Jake Sullivan, the White House national security adviser at the time, sat in on at least one briefing about UAPs, the government's term for unidentified flying objects. If true, it would mean the subject reached the top of the White House.
